caption: The drawing depicts a single, large jug positioned centrally within a lightly outlined square frame on a cream-colored background. The jug is rendered in muted shades of gray and brown, with soft shading indicating its rounded cylindrical shape and gentle highlights suggesting a reflective surface. The jug has a narrow, short neck and a small, curved handle attached to its upper body. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a rectangular box with printed text that reads "WM P. SLUSSER & CO. TALLAHASSEE, FLA." The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," is written in small letters at the bottom right inside the square frame. The overall composition is simple, with all elements rendered in a realistic style using subdued, natural colors.
title: Stoneware Jug
